description: National Physcial Planning - Declaring that the Area of Land comprising Katugahagalge Arajamaha Vihara as Sacred Area and Urban Development Area and directing that an outline physical plan be prepared for the whole of the area
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land-related matters, specifically the declaration of an "Urban Development Area" called the "Katugahagalge Rajamaha Vihara Sacred Area" under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. It includes detailed descriptions of the land boundaries, extent (187 acres), surveyor general's tracing number, and location details. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickramasinghe, the focus is entirely on land designation and planning rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
